course.title: Public Speaking
course.tagline: Speak in front of any crowd without fear, and hold the room.

days.title: Why speaking well matters
days.goal: Say why good speaking helps you in work, school and life.

video.title: Public Speaking for Beginners – Free Full Course

steps: Watch today's video and note the one technique about why speaking well matters you will copy.
Practise why speaking well matters out loud for 10 minutes, standing up as if on a stage.
Record yourself delivering a 1-minute talk using why speaking well matters and watch it back.
Repeat the talk, fixing the weakest moment you spotted in the recording.
Deliver the talk to one real person today and ask them what was clearest.
days.task: Write three reasons why you want to speak well.
days.challenge: Tell a friend why you are learning public speaking.

quiz.q: What is the first job of a speaker?
options: Share one clear message the listeners can remember.
Use big words to impress people.
Talk as long as possible.
Make everyone laugh.
quiz.explain: A speaker's first job is to share one clear message people can remember.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?
options: Give a full one-minute talk with a start, middle and end.
Say why good speaking helps you in work, school and life.
Use a short true story to make a point.
Give a talk to a small group of real people.
quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about Why speaking well matters — its goal is: Say why good speaking helps you in work, school and life.

quiz.q: Which of these did today's lesson focus on?
options: posture and breathing for speakers
eye contact with listeners
answering questions from listeners
why speaking well matters
quiz.explain: Today's focus was why speaking well matters.
